title: Kissed Tangy American Sausages Skillet
description: A tangy and romantic American dish featuring sausages and score-fat, with a plant-based friendly twist, perfect for a night in with loved ones.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced vegan sausages and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the chopped onion and bell pepper to the skillet and cook until tender, about 5 minutes.
Add the diced tomato, tangy barbecue sauce, score-fat, salt, and black pepper to the skillet and stir to combine.
Reduce heat to medium-low and simmer the mixture for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Serve the skillet hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
Let the dish rest for a few minutes before serving to allow the flavors to meld together.
Serve with crusty bread or over rice or roasted vegetables for a filling meal.
